shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and Ethereum saw a slight rebound today despite lingering monthly losses, with the Crypto Fear and Greed Index currently at a neutral 41.
Hotter-than-expected US inflation figures in October have raised expectations of a December Fed interest rate hike, weighing on risk assets.
Ongoing geopolitical uncertainties continue to drive investor risk aversion and contractions across the crypto market.
Ethereum developers have officially set a December 15 test date for the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet.
